description: This file defines the HandlerList class within the AWS SDK for PHP, managing a list of middleware functions and a final handler used to process AWS service commands. It supports adding, removing, and ordering middleware functions across different steps such as init, validate, build, sign, and attempt, enabling flexible request handling.

classes.name: HandlerList
classes.description: Manages a list of middleware functions and a final handler for processing AWS SDK commands, supporting middleware registration, ordering, and resolution.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HandlerList with an optional HTTP handler.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the middleware list with details.

methods.name: setHandler
methods.description: Sets the primary HTTP handler function.

methods.name: hasHandler
methods.description: Checks if a handler has been set.

methods.name: appendInit
methods.description: Appends middleware to the init step.

methods.name: prependInit
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the init step.

methods.name: appendValidate
methods.description: Appends middleware to the validate step.

methods.name: prependValidate
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the validate step.

methods.name: appendBuild
methods.description: Appends middleware to the build step.

methods.name: prependBuild
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the build step.

methods.name: appendSign
methods.description: Appends middleware to the sign step.

methods.name: prependSign
methods.description: Prepends middleware to the sign step.

methods.name: appendAttempt
methods.description: Appends middleware to the attempt step.

methods.name: prependAttempt
methods.description: Prepend middleware to the attempt step.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Adds middleware before a specified middleware by name.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Adds middleware after a specified middleware by name.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a middleware by name or instance.

methods.name: interpose
methods.description: Sets or removes a function to interpose middleware layers.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Composes all middleware and the handler into a single callable, ready to process requests.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of middleware functions across all steps.
